request: Allow modifying the saved Earth rotation speed in the temporary Earth view helper.

behavior.savedSpeed: 0–5× the existing rate, represented exactly as 0–0.015 radians/second in version-1 settings. Default remains 0.003. Copy/import includes the selected rate; older default-rate settings remain supported.
behavior.preview: Separate fast-forward 1×/10×/30×/60× multiplies elapsed visit time. It is not included in copied settings. The 35-minute timeline reflects the selected rate and no longer claims one revolution.
behavior.editing: Saved-rate edits pause and return to the chosen opening. Angle presets and Reset angle retain the selected rate. Reset speed returns to 1× without changing the angle. Use this frame as the start folds the selected rate into the new opening.
behavior.stationary: Zero forces the engine paused, disables UI Play and seek, and still supports copy. Attempted API Play at zero cannot keep reduced-motion rendering alive.
behavior.persistence: Temporary in-memory selection survives Reading/Interactive remount and viewport changes. It does not write browser storage or the database; reload keeps the unchanged production default.
behavior.production: Existing 8K map, opening 120/25/22.5 and normal 0.003 radians/second remain unchanged until the owner submits final settings.

browser.engine: Hidden built-in Chromium; native Safari untested
checks: Motion tab saved speed field/slider set to 0.5×; paused opening stays at 0:00 with rate visible in the pinned footer.
At 0.5×, seek 630 simulated seconds; Earth visibly rotates. Adopting this frame exports longitude −42.1445116398628,latitude 48,roll −10 and rate 0.0015; elapsed resets 0.
Set 2×, then import that exact exported JSON; rate returns 0.5×. Selecting 60× preview and Play advances the timeline while saved rate stays 0.5×.
Set 0×; Play/seek disable, exact zero is copied, and acknowledgment correctly describes a still Earth.
Reset speed restores 1×. A later 0.5× survives selecting Europe preset, closing/reopening, Reading→Interactive remount and portrait resize.
Four mode buttons, saved speed field, fixed footer controls and scrolling timeline are legible at 390×844 CSS viewport/DPR 1; desktop 1280×720/DPR 2 is separately recorded.
Final precision refinement: typing 0.125× then blurring keeps 0.125 in field/slider/footer and exports 0.000375 rad/s. Numeric rate accepts arbitrary in-range precision without two-decimal rounding.
All temporary browser tabs closed and viewport override reset. Main localhost development server preserved.
limits: Native Safari, physical touch and the mobile software keyboard were not tested. Chromium results are not Safari results.
The copy function returned success and exposed exact generated JSON in the textarea. Native OS clipboard bytes were not inspected; import used those exact generated bytes through the form control.
Reduced-motion zero-rate pause and clock isolation are tested in the engine, not via browser reduced-motion emulation.

The first portrait capture method incorrectly scaled/cropped the rendered page; discarded that image and used the documented alternate browser screenshot API. The correct 390×844 captures are retained.
An initial desktop seek screenshot lagged the DOM clock by one step. It was replaced with a settled 10:30 capture; final file and metadata match.
The full rotation still reaches dark regions. Speed changes delay or accelerate them; they do not make every frame luminous.

fullSuite.qualification: Runs final engine/runtime/tests. Subsequent UI-only precision formatting was checked in the live browser and followed by final typecheck/lint/build; existing 0.5×/zero captures are visually unchanged.

lint.command: npm run lint -- [changed TypeScript and test paths]

build.warnings: Existing large-chunk advisory, module.register deprecation and Vinext route-classification notice.

verification.focusedAgentChecks: Core agent independently ran 37 orbit tests, including 6 composition tests, plus scoped lint.
verification.logNormalization: Trailing whitespace and blank EOF lines normalized; results and warnings retained.

performance.classification: Requested design-selection controls, not an optimization experiment.
performance.observations: Selected rate changes one scalar used in the existing rotation calculation. Existing texture/geometry/material resource identity is tested. No new background assets, meshes or rendering pass.
performance.claims: No measured CPU/GPU, memory, heat or battery benefit. Timed test durations are verification logs, not balanced performance comparisons. Held optimization candidates remain unchanged.

addressed: Zero rate forces pause in the engine and has a matching UI acknowledgment.
Final-choice documentation preserves the selected rate as well as the angle.
Exact numeric speed input avoids misleading two-decimal display rounding.
Replaced scaled portrait and stale-frame screenshot evidence.
critic.confirmation: Independently verified all 17 source/capture/log hashes and reviewed 7 final captures. Only evidence filename extensions changed afterward to match the JPEG bytes returned by the browser; hashes and dimensions remain identical.
